description.en:
The language of the request and response.

Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English

description.zh:
VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略组ID。您可调用[DescribeVpcFirewallAclGroupList](~~159760~~)接口获取该ID。

取值：

- VPC边界防火墙防护云企业网时，策略组ID使用云企业网实例ID。

  例如cen-ervw0g12b5jbw*\*\*\*

- VPC边界防火墙防护高速通道时，策略组ID使用VPC边界防火墙实例ID。

   例如vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9*\*\*\*
description.en:
The ID of the policy group for the VPC firewall. Call the [DescribeVpcFirewallAclGroupList](~~159760~~) operation to query the ID.

Valid values:

- If the VPC firewall protects a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, set this parameter to the ID of the CEN instance.

  Example: cen-ervw0g12b5jbw\*\*\*\*
- If the VPC firewall protects an Express Connect circuit, set this parameter to the ID of the VPC firewall instance.

  Example: vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9\*\*\*\*

title.zh: 查询VPC防火墙策略组访问控制策略优先级生效范围

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于查询指定VPC防火墙策略组访问控制策略优先级生效范围。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation queries the effective priority range for access control policies in a specified VPC firewall policy group.

## Limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 for each user. If you exceed the limit, API calls are throttled. This may impact your business. Call this operation an appropriate number of times to prevent interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-firewall-policy-prior-used --lang zh --vpc-firewall-id vfw-a42bbb7b887148c90000 --region cn-hangzhou
